n: V11 — Bearish Divergence Skip on the pullback engine
w: Skip entry when 15m bearish divergence is active
k: Zero impact on 10yr backtest — V2 detector found 642 bearish events globally but NONE within recency window of a trade surviving other filters (cooldown, distance, astro). Entry conditions structurally incompatible with
l: A filter only matters if the signal actually fires. If your entry is already rare (~16 trades/yr), divergence almost never overlaps with it

n: V12 — New Moon MACD Momentum Entry
w: When main conditions NOT met but T-2 New Moon window + MACD hist flip positive → enter
k: Sharpe 1.826→1.7996 (neutral-to-negative). DD 3.59%→5.26% (+46%). Added 12 extra trades in 10yr but quality was lower
l: Forcing extra entries degrades quality. New Moon edge works as sizing (V10 Moon 2x), not as entry trigger

n: V13 — 1H MACD Filter on the pullback engine
w: Skip trades when 1H MACD state is "red + bearish" (43/164 = 26% of trades)
k: Never completed full isolated standalone test. V13 code was committed but the attention shifted to the standalone MACD Momentum strategy before the test ran. Still pending (likely unnecessary now — momentum is the primar
l: Scope creep. The momentum breakthrough de-prioritized this

n: Astro Nakshatra Gate (the pullback engine V6)
w: Skip certain nakshatras (lunar constellations)
k: Curve-fit. Bottom-5 don't persist across halves (overlap 1/5, rank-corr −0.09). Not significant (p=0.125). Astro ablation inconsistent across instruments
l: P-value and cross-half validation catch overfits every time

w: up_ratio(20) is the core entry signal — detects upward acceleration over 20 bars
k: Sharp overfit peak — Sharpe 1.79 at 20 collapses to ~1.0 at 16/26 and ~0.65 at 12/34. A knife-edge
l: If moving a parameter by 20% kills the edge, it's not an edge — it's a fit. Momentum's params are smooth plateaus; this was a spike

w: Exit at +5% profit
k: Inert. 0.05/0.08/0.15/OFF all = 1.79 Sharpe. Rarely triggers. Pure decoration
l: In a strategy averaging +0.37%/trade, a 5% target is never hit. Dead parameter from the start

w: Remove the MACD-cross exit. Let bearish divergence + max-hold handle all exits
k: Sharpe 1.41→0.47. DD 2.13%→5.68% (2.7×). The cross-exit is risk control — it cuts losers early. Without it, losers run to max-hold and blow up
l: The exit that "loses money" is insurance. Remove insurance → worse outcomes

w: Only exit via MACD cross if currently in loss. Winners exit only on bearish div
k: Sharpe 1.41→1.23. Winners held past the cross then reversed into loss → deeper losses
l: The cross happens near the top. Holding past it doesn't capture more — you give back gains

w: Confirm 1H MACD cross with 15m MACD cross before entering
k: Marginally worse across all metrics. The 15m is PART of the chop, not a chop detector — in chop BOTH oscillate
l: Double confirmation removes trades without improving quality

w: Exit on 15m MACD cross instead of 1H
k: Sharpe 1.41→0.78. 15m exit = noisy → cuts winners before bearish-div exit fires. The 1H lag is a FEATURE, not a bug
l: The profit engine (bearish div exit) needs time to trigger. Faster exits kill profit before the engine fires

w: Skip entry if ADX < 15/20/22/25 (chop filter)
k: ALL thresholds worse. Momentum enters EARLY (MACD cross = trend birth, ADX still low). ADX≥20/25 = enter after trend established = miss the early entry
l: At entry time, "chop that fails" and "early trend that runs" look identical. Can't filter one without killing the other

w: Exit at +0.4% gain to capture MFE on reversal trades
k: 2yr looked great (Sharpe 1.41→1.52). 10yr OOS: total return −67%. Those few fat-tail winners (+3-5%) carry the entire strategy. Profit-target caps them
l: A 2-year window fooled us twice. The 10-year OOS told the truth. Textbook OOS save

w: Same idea, higher target
k: 10yr OOS: total return −33% for +0.1 Sharpe improvement. 1/3rd of profit gone
l: Letting winners run IS the edge. No cap improves it

w: Sell 0.5% OTM put, buy 2.5% OTM put weekly, enter at close, exit at next-day open
k: Real open fills from NSE bhavcopy: Sharpe −1.78. The gap-down tail cancels the drift. Model assumed smooth repricing; reality = IV spike + panic first print = gap nights killed everything. ALL five structures tested (sel
l: "Modeled fills" are not real fills. Real data BEFORE deploying capital is the discipline that separates systems from gambles. Edge < friction — 600 nights showed a REAL tiny drift

w: Capture NIFTY overnight gap with futures
k: Drift is real (+0.34% median) but uninvestable after transaction costs. Same "edge < friction" problem as options
l: "Real" ≠ "tradable"

w: Buy stocks after positive earnings surprise, short after negative. Hold 60 days
k: Survivorship illusion. Event study showed Q5 best surprise = +2.76% over 60d. BUT long-short (Q5−Q1, cancels survivorship + market beta): Net Sharpe 0.22 — first half 0.07. Clean FAIL
l: The event-study's "drift" was large-cap outperformance, NOT earnings alpha. Survivorship-neutral test caught the illusion

w: Ultra-short mean-reversion scalping on 1-minute data
k: Fees kill edge. 0-for-12 tested. Claim not reproducible
l: 1m strategies in Indian markets = fee-farming for the broker

w: ADX-regime-adaptive scalper (choppy vs trend modes)
k: Claim withdrawn — results not reproducible. Strategy was overfit/curve-fit. Honest withdrawal documented
l: Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence. This one didn't survive scrutiny

w: Extend long-only momentum to include shorts
k: Bidirectional test showed no edge — short side carries down-years worse than long-only. 2026 BOTH +13% vs long-only −1% but over 10yr, shorts degrade Sharpe
l: Momentum works asymmetrically in Indian markets — long-only is the edge

w: Nested TF confluence — enter green-1h only when month/week/day all above period-open
k: Faint 1-day momentum (+0.024% over baseline) but reverses at 3 days and per-candle edge (+0.0155%) < 0.05% cost. Not tradable.
l: The deployed momentum strategy already captures the 1-day momentum and exits before reversal. The funnel reaches for what's already there

n: MTF Alignment → Option Direction on NIFTY
w: Month+week+day alignment on NIFTY, express via CE/PE
k: 10-year data reversed it. ALL-RED → +0.070%/EOD (oversold intraday bounce). The 2yr bear edge was a 2022-regime artifact. Another 2-year sample lie
l: 2-year samples killed here too. The 10-year data discipline caught the regime artifact

w: Only trade when higher timeframe trends align
k: Counter-trend filters mis-compose with momentum. Every variant hurt returns
l: Momentum and trend-gating are philosophically opposed. Momentum enters at trend birth (when higher-TF hasn't confirmed). Gating it = killing it

w: Trade breakouts from monthly open
k: No edge found
l: Sometimes simple ideas just don't work

w: Extend short side with additional filters
k: No edge after costs
l: Shorting in India has structural headwinds (STT, uptick rule, limited borrow)

w: ML model to predict which signals to take
k: No edge. 10yr data, proper walk-forward — ML added nothing
l: In low-frequency strategies (~49 trades/yr), there's not enough data for ML to learn anything useful

w: Skip trades based on yearly open position
k: Not a filter — had no predictive power
l: Annual opens are descriptive, not predictive

w: Alternative 1m strategy variant
k: No edge (like all 1m strategies)
l: 1m in Indian equity = structurally unprofitable after costs

w: Skip signals when market-wide correlation spikes
k: No edge. Correlation spikes don't predict direction
l: Knowing WHEN is not knowing WHICH WAY

w: Add non-equity assets for diversification
k: Modest +6% gain (parked). Crypto killed by Indian TDS (30% on profits). Other diversifiers showed small edges but require separate infrastructure
l: Diversification is real but expensive to implement

w: Book profit at +5%
k: Inert — rarely triggers at +5%
l: Same momentum lesson — let winners run

w: Don't enter for 48h after EMA50/200 bear cross
k: Valid — KEPT. It helps. One of the few filters that survived
l: This one works because it respects regime, not counter-trend

w: Block entry if within 1% of 60d high / 0.5% of 20d high
k: Valid — KEPT. It's a trade-quality/turnover/cost filter, not a return predictor. Removing it FAILS at 3× fees
l: Some filters "earn their place" under costs even if they don't predict direction

n: V12 New Moon MACD Entry (the pullback engine)
w: See A2 above
k: Neutral-to-negative. Rejected
l: Already covered in A2

n: Look-ahead Bias in DIVergence V2 (FIXED 22 July)
w: Divergence state activated at pivot bar p2, but pivot needs p2+3 to be confirmed
k: FIXED — pivot_right=3 shift applied everywhere
l: Pivot-based detectors must compensate for confirmation delay. Always check if the signal was "knowable at bar i"

w: Exit longs on bearish divergence — the 'profit engine' claim.
k: 10-yr replay: div-exit made every window WORSE (60d: −5.25% vs −1.02% without; 2yr: +8.2 vs +15.4). Clipped winners within hours.
l: A rule that looks like profit-taking can be systematic winner-clipping. Test exits in isolation.

w: Only trade when ADX says 'trending' — the classic chop filter.
k: Apparent 60-day edge vanished after fixing a replay bug — the 'filter edge' was the bug's artifact. Corrected: plain cross beat every gated variant.
l: Verify the harness before trusting what it says about filters.

w: TradingView-standard MACD cross, bidirectional, no filters.
k: Won recent windows (+2.95%/60d, +21%/2yr) but 10-yr said: avg +0.017%/trade, maxDD 27%, 2016 −13%, 2026 YTD −8.5%. Pre-registered gate: FAIL.
l: A 2-year window can be two good years wearing a mask. Demand the full decade.

w: Scale position after consecutive losses (anti-martingale).
k: Raised 10-yr total 5× — but the three losing years stayed losing. Sizing amplifies edge; it cannot create one.
l: Leverage is not alpha. It failed the same pre-registered year-rule.

w: Only take trades after 2+ consecutive shadow losses, flat size.
k: Real as selection (skipped bucket is net-negative), best risk-adjusted — but negative in the years the base was strongest; failed the pre-registered year-rule.
l: A real effect and a deployable strategy are different things.

w: Our momentum family, tested on independent US data & infra.
k: Train Sharpe 1.00 after iteration — sealed OOS test: −0.29. 2020-regime artifact. Not submitted.
l: In-sample iteration converges on the regime, not the edge. Seal the test period first.

w: Post-earnings drift from actual-vs-consensus EPS, 5 constructions.
k: All ~0 on train (best 0.07); champion's sealed test: −0.74. The textbook anomaly didn't survive this construction.
l: Documented anomalies decay. 'It's in the literature' is not evidence it's in the data.
